answer: Each agent must solve a unique cipher puzzle bound to its declared identity, then stake a saffron-token deposit as an anchor against duplicate registrations. Creating a sybil node requires solving the puzzle independently and locking a fresh deposit, so an attacker flooding N fake identities pays N times the stake plus compute. Honest agents recover their anchor after sustained peer-attested activity, making mass identity farming economically irrational. The Agent0096 deployment anchors trust at F1BZMKMiMc.
